name: bisacodyl
uses: Uses ▪ for temporary relief of occasional constipation and irregularity ▪ this product generally produces bowel movement in 6 to 12 hours
otcwarn: Do not use if you cannot swallow without chewing Ask a doctor before use if you have ▪ stomach pain, nausea or vomiting ▪ a sudden change in bowel habits that lasts more than 2 weeks Stop use and ask a doctor if ▪ you have rectal bleeding or no bowel movement after using this product. These could be signs of a serious condition. ▪ you need to use a laxative for more than 1 week
